brief: Draft the pull request body for Slice 5 PR-A of the SPLIT / Alpine UI redesign cycle: the backend narrative intake field. Branch feat/slice-5-onboarding-backend, two commits over the evidence commit: the build (6265c38d) and the round-1 fix (ebc49672). Open with one bold sentence naming the PR's place in the slice (PR-A is the backend root; PR-B, the frontend recomposition, follows and consumes the regenerated contract). Then the same sections as the shape example: 'Spec' pointer (docs/specs/slice-5-onboarding/spec.md is gitignored; the committed evidence dir is docs/plans/split-ui-cycle/slice-5-evidence/); 'What's here' (the wire shape and its nullable-not-required swagger proof; the mapper bound 1000 and normalization; the first-event-only AnswerCaptured attachment with tri-state semantics and why not a new event type; the working-view copy that feeds inline plan generation; the state DTO empty-as-null; the composer block bytes and why an empty narrative is byte-identical so no fixture re-record; the new eval scenario and its funded-key record; codegen and the hand-written models); 'Decision record' (DEC-089 D7 build note: manifest regen is a verified no-op because the composer is C#; the backend/REVIEW.md additive-nullable exception and the DEC-091 / Slice 2 precedent; the four cycle-plan Captured rows C1-C4); 'Review trail' (six recon lenses, two-family spec red-team with the counts and the two sol findings rejected, two round-1 lenses, mutation probes M1-M22 all red, one fix round with F1-F3, and that the maintainer's own code-gauntlet run is the cross-family pass still to come); 'Green' (the measured numbers from build-orchestrator-runs.md and round1/orchestrator-runs.md); 'Notes for review' (the ROADMAP/cycle-plan Status edits ride here; the narrative stays unsanitized like the nuance fields by decision; the frontend does not send the field until PR-B). Do not name a Codex model, token count, account, or cost. Do not include a footer; the orchestrator appends the generated-with line.
